# Template: equation_steps
Handwritten math: an equation or a short derivation revealed line by line — choose for ANY request to show a formula, identity, or algebra steps. Each step is typeset via MathJax and drawn as exact filled glyph shapes (counters and all), stacked top to bottom, with an optional short note beside each one, and optionally colours picked out per term across every step.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "steps": {
   "type": "array",
   "minItems": 1,
   "maxItems": 4,
   "items": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
     "tex": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "REQUIRED. A LaTeX math expression (no surrounding $ or \\[ \\])."
     },
     "note": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "A short guide note shown to the right of this step."
     }
    },
    "required": [
     "tex"
    ]
   }
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  },
  "colors": {
   "type": "object",
   "additionalProperties": {
    "type": "string"
   },
   "description": "Colour per term: a TeX snippet → colour, e.g. {\"x\": \"#2f6b8f\"} — every occurrence, in every step."
  },
  "size": {
   "type": "number",
   "minimum": 20,
   "maximum": 56,
   "description": "Formula size (default 30, the body-text size). When the steps ARE the figure and nothing shares the page, 40–48 fills it; the notes and gaps grow with it."
  }
 },
 "required": [
  "steps"
 ]
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- step_<i>: steps[i]'s typeset glyphs (one group of filled shapes)
- note_<i>: its guide note, present when given
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Show the quadratic formula." → params: {"title":"The quadratic formula","steps":[{"tex":"ax^2+bx+c=0","note":"The general quadratic equation."},{"tex":"a\\left(x+\\frac{b}{2a}\\right)^2=\\frac{b^2-4ac}{4a}","note":"Complete the square."},{"tex":"x=\\frac{-b\\pm\\sqrt{b^2-4ac}}{2a}","note":"Solve for x."}]}

In YAML: `template: equation_steps` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
